rationale: Ruthless, historically grounded, and unrelenting — hits Yorktown, Cornwallis, Valley Forge, the 1812 rematch and humiliating defeat themes with no conciliatory language. The barb about being "dumped... by your own kid" and vivid tactical insults demonstrate full adherence to the top band.
quote: You had the biggest empire on Earth, the most feared navy in history, professional soldiers in snappy red coats — and you got absolutely folded by a bunch of farmers with muskets and an attitude problem.
